Priya (Customer): hey team :wave: after bumping @redwood/sdk from v0.19.3 -> v0.20.0 my TypeScript build started failing and I get runtime 404s in prod. Node 18, tsconfig target es2020. error: 'Property \u0027model\u0027 does not exist on type RequestOptions'. Also calls to /v1/generate return 404. repro below

Priya (Customer): sample client call (TS)
```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-alpha', prompt: 'hi' })
```

Jamie (Support): thanks Priya. can you paste the exact npm package version from package.json and the raw 404 response body? also is this on hosted or dedicated?

Priya (Customer): package.json shows "@redwood/sdk": "^0.20.0". hosted. curl output: HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "unknown_route",
  "message": "/v1/generate not found"
}

release-bot: heads-up: breaking changes in @redwood/sdk v0.20.0 documented in release notes: route reorg ("/v1/generate" -> "/v1/text/generate") and RequestOptions param rename ("model" -> "modelName") for clearer typing. See: https://redwood.example.com/releases/v0.20.0 :information_source:

Alex (DevEx): yep this looks like a client/server mismatch. hosted API was updated to expect new route/param shape. two quick options:
1) pin SDK to 0.19.x until your environment is ready to use the new API
2) change calls to the new shape or override basePath in client as a temporary shim. e.g.
```ts
// option: new param name
await client.generate({ modelName: 'redwood-alpha', prompt: 'hi' })

// or override basePath (not long-term)
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: RW_KEY, basePath: '/v1' })
```

Priya (Customer): trying the modelName change now...

Priya (Customer): ok that fixed the TS error and requests to /v1/text/generate succeed. thanks! :thumbsup:

Jamie (Support): glad that worked. we'll add a compatibility note in the SDK upgrade guide and flag this for docs and an assisted rollout path for hosted customers so this mismatch doesn't surprise folks. can you paste a minimal repro (package.json + failing snippet) in a GH issue?

Priya (Customer): will do, posting shortly. steps to repro I used: upgrade to @redwood/sdk@0.20.0, run tsc, attempt client.generate({ model: 'x', prompt: 'y' }) -> compile error + runtime 404. thanks all.

Alex (DevEx): filing internal doc task to add automated compat warning in console for customers upgrading.

Jamie (Support): marking this thread resolved, re-open if anything else pops up :white_check_mark:
